categories.name: Allies
categories.description: The army may take allied  contingents from any or all of the Illyrian, Thracian Highland Tribes or Later Hoplite Greek - Athens Lists.

units.name: King or General
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Hipparch
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Tribal Commander
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Royal Guard Cavalry
units.description: Royal Guard Cavalry have light armour and Javelins. Superior Fighters. This unit has a maximum of six bases

units.name: Noble Cavalry
units.description: Noble Cavalry have javelins. Superior Fighters, May have light armour (+1).

units.name: Light Cavalry
units.description: Light Cavalry have javelins. Evade.

units.name: Royal Guard Infantry
units.description: Royal Guard Infantry have light armour, large shield and spear. Superior Fighters. Phalanx. This unit has a maximum of six bases.

units.name: Trained Infantry
units.description: Trained Infantry have javelins and shield. Up to two units may have light armour (+2).

units.name: Tribal Infantry
units.description: Tribal Infantry have spear and shield. Open Order. Warband. May exchange spear for throwing spear (+2).

units.name: Skirmishers
units.description: Skirmishers have javelin and shield. Skirmishers.Up to half may exchange javelins for bow or sling (free), but there must be more sling bases than bow bases in the army, if any are used.

reformed_macedonian_army.armyName: Reformed Macedonian Army - 359 BC to 328 BC

categories.name: Allies
categories.description: The army may take allied contingents from the Illyrian, Thracian or Later Hoplite Greek lists.

units.name: Philip
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Alexander
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Young Alexander
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Strategos
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Hipparch
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Agema Cavalry
units.description: Agema Cavalry have heavy armour and spear. Superior Fighters. Wedge. Stubborn. This unit has a maximum of four and must accompany the Alexander or Philip at all times.

units.name: Hetairoi (Companions)
units.description: Hetairoi (Companions) have light armour and spear. Superior Fighters. Wedge. May have heavy armour (+1). May be upgraded to C9 (+2).

units.name: Thessalian Cavalry
units.description: Thessalian Cavalry have light armour and javelins. Superior Shooters. Wedge. May exchange javelins for spear (-2), losing Superior Shooters.  May have heavy armour (+1). One unit may be Stubborn (+2).  There may not be more Thessalian units than Hetairoi (Companions) units..

units.name: Greek Cavalry
units.description: Greek Cavalry have ligt armour and javelins.

units.name: Prodromoi
units.description: Prodromoi have Kontos. Wedge. There may not be more Prodromoi units than Agema and companion units in the army.

units.name: Paeonians
units.description: Paeonians have javelins and shield. Evade. May be fielded as Skirmishers at a cost of 19 points per base.

units.name: Light Cavalry
units.description: Light Cavalry have javelins. May be fielded as Skirmishers. (These may be Greeks, Thracians or Illyrians).

units.name: Agema Infantry
units.description: Agema Infantry have light armour, pike and shield. Superior Fighters. Trained Phalanx. Stubborn.

units.name: Hypaspists
units.description: Hypaspists Infantry have pike and shield. They may have light armour (+2). Superior FIghters. Trained Phalanx. Drilled. One unit may be Stubborn (+2). Hypaspists may alternatively be fielded with spear and large shield (free), or with javelins and shield at 21 oints per base, in which case they are Drilled and Open Order but no longer Phalanx.  Troops in this last configuration may be fielded as Skirmishers at twelve points per base, losing the  Drilled rule.  There may not be more units of Agema and Hypaspists in the army than there are of Pezhetairoi.

units.name: Pezhetairoi
units.description: Pezhetairoi have pike and shield. Trained Phalanx. May have light armour (+2). May be drilled (+3). At least on unit of Pezhetairoi must be fielded.

units.name: Greek Hoplites
units.description: Greek Hoplites have light armour, spear and shield. Trained Phalanx.

units.name: Greek Peltasts
units.description: Greek Peltasts have javelins and shield. Open Order.

units.name: Agrianians
units.description: Agrianians have javelin and shield. Skirmishers. May replace javelins with sling (free). There may be one unit of Agrianians for every two units of other Skirmishers.

units.name: Cretans
units.description: Cretans have bow and shield. Superior Shooters. Skirmishers. This unit may not be the largest unit of Skirmishers in the army.

units.name: Mercenaries
units.description: Mercenaries have javelin and shield. Skirmishers. Inferior Fighters.  Every second unit of Mercenaries may replace javelins and shield with bow (-1).

units.name: Skirmishers
units.description: Skirmishers have javelins and shield. Skirmishers. Inferior Fighters.

units.name: Hipparch
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Greek Cavalry
units.description: Greek Cavalry have heavy javelins and light armour. May have heavy armour (+1) and may exchange javelins for spear (free).

units.name: Theban Sacred Band
units.description: Theban Sacred Band have light armour, spear and large shield. Superior Fighters. Trained Phalnax. Drilled. Stubborn. Veteran. This is a single  compulsory unit with a maximum of six bases.

units.name: Theban Hoplites
units.description: Theban Hoplites have light armour, spear and large shield. Trained Phalanx. May be Veteran (+2) and may pay an extra 2 points per base to gain an extra +1 Combat Resolution for a third row of bases in a unit.

units.name: Allied Hoplites
units.description: Allied Hoplites have spear and large shield. Phalanx. Every 2nd unit may have light armour (+2). Every second unit may be upgraded to Trained Phalanx (+2).

units.name: Athenian Hoplites
units.description: Athenian Hoplites have spear and large shield. Phalanx. Every 2nd unit may have light armour (+2). Every third unit may be upgraded to Trained Phalanx (+2). One unit may be upgraded to C7 (+2).

units.name: Peltasts
units.description: Peltasts have javelins and shield. Open Order. May have spear (free). Every second unit may be Veteran (+2). May be fielded as Skirmishers at a cost of seven points per base.

units.name: Psiloi
units.description: Psiloi have javelins and shield. Skirmishers. Inferior Fighters. Up to half of all Psiloi units may replace javelins with sling (free). Every other other unit may upgraded to Mercenary (C6, not Inferior Fighhters) at a cost of +2 points per base.

categories.name: Infantry
categories.description: Must include two highland warrior units for each lowland warrior unit.

units.name: King
units.description: May Ride a horse.

units.name: Chieftain
units.description: Rides a horse.

units.name: Minor Chieftain
units.description: Rides a horse.

units.name: Nobles
units.description: Nobles have light armour, javelins and spears. Superior Fighters. May have heavy armour (+1). May fight in Wdge (+2). May be fielded as Skirmihser.

units.name: Warriors
units.description: Warriors have javelins. May have spear (+1) or be fielded as Skirmishers.

units.name: Highland Warriors
units.description: Highland Warriors have javelins and shield. Open Order. Warband. May add Halberd (+2).Every second unit may instead be fielded as Skirmishers at a cost of seven points per base.  Every second unit of Skirmishers may replace javelins and shield with bow (-1).

units.name: Skirmishers
units.description: Skirmishers have javelins and shield. Skirmishers. Every second unit may replace javelins and shield with bow or sling (-1).
